versions.changelog:
Self-Improvement Skill v1.0.0 – Initial release for OpenClaw and other agents.

- Enables structured logging of learnings, errors, and feature requests to markdown files for agent self-improvement.
- Details workflows for categorizing, promoting, and tracking learnings—including commands for promoting insights to project memory.
- Provides file structure and templates for integration with OpenClaw and generic projects.
- Defines markdown formats for learnings, errors, and feature request entries, and processes for status/resolution tracking.
- Offers setup instructions for OpenClaw users (with hook support) and generic agent integration.
